payload.title: Issue and roundup as a Caducus notification kind: scheduled approval, exactly-once send
payload.description:
**Goal.** The roundup/issue is a Caducus notification kind. Editors still write the issue in the newsroom; an admin approves it for a time; the site backend sends it exactly once with nobody present; the web archive keeps working. The newsletter plugin's issue, approval, scheduler and send-ledger code is deleted.

**Design.** Caducus gains a generic "scheduled digest" kind: a draft payload (subject, rendered HTML and text in S3, content hash), an approval record, a schedule (UTC, shown in the publication zone), a send ledger keyed by (issue, recipient) giving exactly-once, and fan-out through the existing email queue with dead letter. At fire time it re-checks the issue is still approved and unchanged (content hash); an edited issue returns to draft and nothing is sent. Papyrus supplies the draft (Item of the issue type in the archive section) and the panel. The cadence (e.g. weekly) assembles a draft and notifies admins; no approval, no issue. Only admins approve.

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Issues through notifications
  Scenario: Approved issue sends once
    Given an admin approved an issue for Friday 09:00 in the publication time zone
    When the scheduled time passes and the sender runs twice (retry)
    Then every confirmed subscriber receives it exactly once

  Scenario: Edited after approval
    Given an issue approved for a time
    When an editor changes it before the time
    Then it returns to draft and nothing is sent

  Scenario: No approval, no issue
    Given the weekly cadence assembled a draft and nobody approved it
    When the time passes
    Then nothing is sent and admins are told it was missed

  Scenario: Only admins approve
    When an editor tries to approve an issue
    Then it is refused

  Scenario: Failure mid-send
    Given the send fails after half the recipients
    When it resumes
    Then the first half is not mailed again and the rest are

  Scenario: Suppressed and paused
    Given a subscriber is suppressed or the site is paused
    Then they are skipped, or nothing goes out, and the issue shows why

  Scenario: Web archive
    When an issue is sent
    Then its archive page is published with the same content
```

**Depends on:** ownership story. Blocks selection story and MoM launch.
**Related:** PPY-19a098 (M2 as built), PPY-31455f decisions of 2026-10-20 (admins approve, scheduler, hash re-check).

**Open questions for Ryan:** (1) Keep the web archive as a page per issue as today? (2) One approver per site or any admin?
